card.name: Words leading into noticing or pregnancy
card.fires_on: Small linking words just before a clause about becoming aware of something, such as 'prior to' pregnancy, 'as soon as she' remembers, or 'when pregnancy is' detected. It fires on the word right before the awareness or discovery idea.

modes.label: Prior to pregnancy
modes.description: The word 'to' or 'before' after 'prior' or in timing phrases about pregnancy or conception.
modes.example: women who have used oral contraceptives prior<< to>> pregnancy. 56,57

modes.label: On realizing or detecting
modes.description: A pronoun or verb right before 'remembers', 'detected' or 'discovering' in instructions.
modes.example: she should take it off as soon as<< she>> remembers.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like aware, awareness and realization as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on little words just before a phrase about noticing, realizing or finding out, often around pregnancy or a missed dose.
